_about: OmniSight design-system tokens — the SINGLE SOURCE for the UI shell's look. Values mirror the productizer brand (app/globals.css): deep-space dark theme + neural-blue accent + holo-glass surfaces + domain colors. A build step compiles this to (a) a QML theme singleton Theme.qml for launcher-qt and (b) a Tailwind v4 @theme preset / CSS vars for launcher-web, so both renderers are pixel-consistent + on-brand. Do NOT hardcode colors in either renderer — read from here.

category_accent._note: Each launcher category gets a domain color, so the home screen reads at a glance.

display.use: launcher title, clock, brand wordmark, tile section headers

surface._note: Tiles/cards use holo-glass (glassmorphism): card bg + blue border + subtle blur + neural-blue glow on focus/active.

_breakpoints_note: 3xl=2160 keeps the productizer's 4K awareness; the launcher's adaptive grid (from pos-kiosk AdaptiveGrid + DIP engine) reflows tiles across 7" panel → 4K.

icons._note: lucide is open-source SVG → launcher-web uses lucide-react natively; launcher-qt ships the same lucide SVGs as a QML icon provider, so manifest `icon` ids resolve identically in both. Custom omnisight glyphs (logo mark) live under icons/omnisight/.
